platform: Apple Silicon macOS native Metal studio, locked release build

scene_selection.method: Select Harbor back, enable Select multiple, then select Harbor front in the Scene. Both piece rows, 2D outlines and 3D wire edges show the selection.

camera: Front, 270 screen points per metre with 10 mm snapping

group_rotation.pivot: Mean of both placed pattern bounds centers

reopen.procedure: Reselect both patterns. File > New Empty, then open the saved revision 28 project through the native file chooser.

limits: This native case covers view-plane translation and active-pattern Local Z rotation in the front camera. Rotation about the other axes is covered separately by source tests. Persistent groups, constrained translation and complete reference arrangement behavior remain open.
